svg.text: 永远相信美好的事情即将发生
Always believe that something wonderful is about to happen.
「人们总幻想天马行空，我只希望灵感一直停在顶峰。」
People dream of wandering the sky — I only ask that inspiration stay at its peak.
「我写代码，也拆代码。造工具的手，和破工具的手，是同一双。」
I build code and I break it. The hands that make tools are the hands that take them apart.
— AI 编程工具链，终端 / 模型 / 自动化接在一起
AI coding toolchain — terminal, models and automation in one place
— 移动端加固样本的脱壳与分析流水线
Unpacking and analysis pipeline for hardened mobile samples
— 让一切自己跑起来，然后忘掉它
Make everything run itself, then forget about it
Slow is fast. Less is more.
I don't believe in luck; I believe in compounding.
永远相信美好的事情即将发生。
Always believe that something wonderful is about to happen.
